phase: Before the GPflow installation in py313
evidence: Recorded from the successful command outputs observed during this session; exact per-check timestamps were not retained.
scope: Small deterministic CPU numerical checks and Python module-discovery checks. No GPU, GP model workload, sampler convergence, project regression suite, or comprehensive oracle certification was tested here.

cholmod_sparse_solve.input: The same matrix in CSC sparse storage
cholmod_sparse_solve.comparison: CHOLMOD Cholesky solve against the same expected solution using numpy.allclose

flint_arb_enclosure.comparison: The product of the Arb sqrt(2) enclosure with itself contains 2

cvxpy_least_squares.problem: Minimize sum_squares(A @ x - b) for the same two-variable system
cvxpy_least_squares.comparison: Each solver reports optimal and its solution matches the expected solution using numpy.allclose with atol=1e-5

arbplusjax_backend_presence.checker: tools/check_oracle_backends_present.py --check in the local arbPlusJAX checkout
arbplusjax_backend_presence.method: The checker scans test importorskip calls and uses importlib.util.find_spec; this establishes module discoverability, not successful imports or numerical correctness.
arbplusjax_backend_presence.impact: The five listed Arb verification files would skip when their importorskip guards cannot find flint. The numerical smoke above ran in py313 only.

post_gpflow_numerical_rerun.scope: Same numerical calculations after installing GPflow; backend-presence counts above were not rerun.
